blocks.title: Unsaturated hydrocarbons
blocks.text: Alkenes unsaturated hydrocarbons hain. Unsaturated hydrocarbons sirf hydrogen aur carbon ke compounds hain jin ke molecules mein carbon-carbon double bond (ya triple bond) hota hai.
Alkenes mein utne hi carbon wale saturated hydrocarbon (alkane) se do hydrogen atoms kam hote hain.
Alkenes ke naam rakhne ke IUPAC rules kaafi had tak alkanes wale rules jaise hain.
1. Sab se lambi continuous chain chunein jis mein C=C ho; yahi parent chain hai. Utni hi lambai wale alkane ke naam ke aakhir mein –ane ki jagah –ene laga dein. Maslan:
2. Chain ko aise number dein ke double bond ke dono carbon atoms chain mein shamil hon. Numbering us sire se shuru hoti hai jo double bond ke zyada qareeb ho.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki is misal mein carbon 5 (jis par CH₃ laga hai) ‘CH₂’ aur double bond wala carbon 3 sirf ‘C’ chhapa hai. Carbon ke chaar bond hote hain, is liye dono CH hain. Oopar sahi formula hai: H₃C–CH(CH₃)–CH₂–CH=CH–CH₃.
3. Double bond ki jagah batane ke liye double bond ke pehle atom ka number naam se pehle (prefix) likhein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein 1-butene aur 1-pentene ke formulas rule 4 ki likhai ke saath mil gaye hain: 1-butene mein carbon 2 ‘CH₂’ chhapa hai aur carbon 3 ghaib hai. Sahi formulas oopar hain.
4. Substituent groups ki jagah un carbon atoms ke numbers se batayein jin se woh jure hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki dono misalon mein carbon 1 ‘H₂C’ chhapa hai; sahi H₃C hai. 2,5,5-trimethyl-2-hexene mein carbon 4 ‘CH₃’ chhapa hai; sahi CH₂ hai. Oopar sahi formulas hain.
5. Agar parent chain mein aik se zyada double bonds hon to do double bonds wale alkadienes, teen wale alkatrienes, waghaira kehlate hain.

blocks.prompt: CH₃C(CH₃)=CH–CH₃ aur CH₂=CHCH(CH₃)₂ ke naam rakhein, aur 3-methylbut-2-ene ka formula banayein (Quick Check 11.4b, c).
blocks.explanation: CH₃C(CH₃)=CHCH₃: chaar carbon ki chain, double bond C2 par aur methyl C2 par: 2-methylbut-2-ene. CH₂=CHCH(CH₃)₂: chaar carbon ki chain, double bond C1 par aur methyl C3 par: 3-methylbut-1-ene. ‘3-Methylbut-2-ene’ (kitab mein 3-methyl-2-butene) CH₃CH=C(CH₃)CH₃ hai; sahi numbering (double bond ko chhota number) se yeh wahi molecule hai jo 2-methylbut-2-ene.

items: C=C wali sab se lambi chain, –ane se –ene; double bond ke qareeb wale sire se number; double bond ka pehla carbon us ka number deta hai; substituents ke numbers; do double bonds: –diene, teen: –triene.
